Question: who does what when I check in?

Here is the check-in exchange at Lakeside Inn.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant G as Guest
    participant F as Front desk
    participant C as Concierge
    G->>F: Give name
    F->>G: Request ID
    G->>F: Show ID and card for incidentals
    F-->>G: Key cards and Wi-Fi code
    opt Arrival before 3 pm
        F->>C: Send guest to store luggage
        C-->>G: Luggage stored
    end
```

The desk handles ID, card and keys [1][2]; the concierge only comes in if you arrive before 3 pm [2].

Question: Sequence diagram of how a support ticket gets escalated

This is how a Taskly ticket moves between the customer and the support tiers.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Customer
    participant T1 as Tier 1
    participant T2 as Tier 2
    participant P as Product team
    C->>T1: Open ticket
    T1-->>C: First response within 4 hours
    T1->>T2: Escalate unsolved issue
    T2->>P: File bug after reproducing
    P-->>T2: Fix shipped
    T2-->>T1: Fix confirmed
    T1-->>C: Update customer
```

Tier 1 remains your single point of contact the whole way through, even after escalation [2]. First response is within 4 hours [1].

Question: what happens after I place a delivery order online

After you place an online order at Nonna Rosa, the messages flow like this.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Customer
    participant W as Website
    participant K as Kitchen
    participant D as Driver
    C->>W: Place order
    W->>K: Send to kitchen display
    W-->>C: Email confirmation
    K->>D: Mark done and alert driver
    D-->>C: Text on the way
    D->>C: Hand over order
```

The website fans the order out to both the kitchen and your inbox [1]; the driver is only alerted once the kitchen marks it done [2].

Question: refill process between me, pharmacy and doctor?

Here is the refill exchange between you, Corner Pharmacy and your doctor.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant P as Patient
    participant Ph as Pharmacist
    participant D as Doctor
    P->>Ph: Request refill in app
```

The doctor is only contacted when you are out of refills [1]. Pick up within 10 days or it returns to stock [2].

Question: Who talks to who when I ask for a ticket refund?

A StageLine refund passes through four parties.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant B as Buyer
    participant S as Support
    participant O as Organizer
    participant P as Payment processor
    B->>S: Request refund
    S->>O: Forward eligible request
    O-->>S: Approve
    S->>P: Issue refund
    P-->>B: Money back to card in 5 to 7 days
    S-->>B: Confirmation email
```

Only cancelled or postponed events qualify [1]; after organizer approval the money reaches your original card in 5 to 7 business days [2].

Question: how do lab results get to me?

Here is how your pet's lab results travel back to you at Oakridge.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant V as Vet
    participant L as Outside lab
    participant F as Front desk
    participant O as Owner
    V->>L: Send blood sample
    L-->>V: Results within 48 hours
    V->>F: Reviewed results
    F->>O: Phone call with results
    opt Abnormal results
        F->>O: Book follow-up on same call
    end
```

Expect a call from the front desk within about 48 hours [1][2]; if anything is abnormal, the follow-up is booked on that same call [2].
